name: Chapter 1: Home
walkthroughIntro: Chapter 1 is your introduction to The Portal. Most of this chapter is designed to teach the basics: combat, farming, equipment, and how your home plot works.
The game explains most of these systems directly, so the walkthrough stays light here. Follow the objectives in order and use the notes below whenever a step needs a little extra context.

parts.name: First Steps
objectives: Find something to eat
Find something to test your strength on
Try out your new abilities
Take down the training dummy with your upgraded skill
Lock on and destroy the training dummy once more

walkthrough.text: Start by following the opening prompts to find something to eat and something to test your strength on.
The game then introduces your abilities through the training dummy. Use your abilities as instructed, then defeat the dummy with your upgraded skill.
For the final step, use the lock-on system and destroy the training dummy once more.

parts.name: Marta's Lessons
objectives: Talk to Marta at home
Get a Hoe (from Leaf, or Rendall at night)
Get a Watering Can (from Leaf, or Rendall at night)

walkthrough.text: Speak with Marta at home. She will send you to get the basic farming tools you need.
Get both a Hoe and a Watering Can.
During the day, Leaf can provide them. Rendall is the nighttime alternative listed by the quest.
Once you have both tools, return to the quest flow and continue.

parts.name: Working the Land
objectives: Talk to Marta about farming
Till soil on your farm plot (0/5)
Plant wheat seeds (0/5)
Water your crops (0/5)
Harvest Wheat (0/5)

walkthrough.text: Talk to Marta about farming, then head to your farm plot.
This part walks you through the basic crop cycle. Till five pieces of soil, plant five Wheat Seeds, and water all five crops.
Once the Wheat has grown, harvest all five.
This establishes the basic farming sequence used throughout the game: prepare the soil, plant, water, and harvest.

parts.name: Trial by Scrap
objectives: Prepare your equipment
Go to Scrap Fields in Goblin Junkyard
Kill Cog Crabs and collect Scrap Metal (0/3)
Bring the Scrap Metal to Marta

walkthrough.text: Prepare your equipment, then travel to the Scrap Fields in the Goblin Junkyard.
Defeat Cog Crabs until you collect the three required Scrap Metal.
Once you have all three, bring the Scrap Metal back to Marta.

parts.name: The Empty House
objectives: Return home
Talk to the stranger at your plot
Clean up the wreckage (0/50)

walkthrough.text: Return home and speak with the stranger waiting at your plot.
After the conversation, clear the wreckage around the property until all 50 pieces have been cleaned up.
Completing the cleanup finishes Chapter 1.

source: User-supplied in-game Main Quest screenshots on 2026-08-18

name: Chapter 2: Stranger in the Village
walkthroughIntro: Chapter 2 continues teaching several of The Portal's larger systems, including farm animals, seasons, skills, equipment upgrades, village NPCs, and the quest board.
Like Chapter 1, most objectives are straightforward, so the walkthrough focuses on keeping the sequence clear rather than over-explaining tutorial prompts.

parts.name: Something to Feed
parts.description: The wreckage is cleared. The ground where the house stood looks bigger than it should. Theron said work is the best thing for today. Fine. Start with something that complains when it is hungry.
objectives: Open Build mode and place your Animal Plot
Talk to Hogan the rancher
Buy a Chicken from Hogan
Buy a Hay Bundle (from Hogan, or Rendall at night)
Put your chicken in the Animal Plot
Feed your chicken

walkthrough.text: Start by opening Build Mode and placing the Animal Plot you received at the end of Chapter 1.
Next, visit Hogan the rancher.
Buy a Chicken and a Hay Bundle. The quest also lists Rendall as a nighttime source for the Hay Bundle.
Return to the Animal Plot, place the Chicken inside, and feed it.
This completes the game's introduction to farm animals.

parts.name: Asking Around
parts.description: The chicken is fed. The quiet comes back anyway. These folk have known this village longer than you have been alive. Someone saw something that night. Ask around. Keep the letter out of it.
objectives: Ask Arlette about that night
Ask Breda about the attack
Ask Leaf what grows this season
Check the season marker by your minimap

walkthrough.text: This part sends you around the village to speak with several residents.
Talk to Arlette about the night of the attack, then speak with Breda.
Next, visit Leaf and ask what grows during the current season.
Finally, check the season marker near your minimap. This is the game's introduction to seasonal farming information.

parts.name: The Elder's Guidance
parts.description: Theron waves you in before you knock. Tea already poured. He asks his questions gently, and you answer all but one. The letter stays where it is. Then he says the word you needed: stronger.
objectives: Visit Elder Theron
Ask Neria for a skill book
Buy your job's skill book from Neria
Learn the skill from your backpack
Place your new skill in a quick slot
Cast your new skill
Show Eren your weapon
Upgrade your weapon twice (0/2)

walkthrough.text: Visit Elder Theron first.
After speaking with him, go to Neria and ask for a skill book. Buy the skill book for your current job, open your backpack, and learn it.
Place the new skill in a quick slot and cast it.
Then visit Eren, show him your weapon, and upgrade that weapon twice.
This section introduces the basic skill-learning and weapon-upgrade flow.

parts.name: Mind Who's Listening
parts.description: A sharper blade, a new skill, a fed chicken. The village calls that healing. At night the tavern is warm and loud, and Rendall pours without being asked. You almost feel safe. Almost is worth something.
objectives: Have supper at the tavern
Tell Theron you are ready
Take a bounty from the village quest board

walkthrough.text: Have supper at the tavern, then speak with Theron and tell him you are ready.
Finally, visit the village quest board and accept a bounty.
Taking the bounty completes Chapter 2.

dataStatus: Complete for all four currently available Chapter 2 parts shown in the quest menu

name: Chapter 3: The Junkyard
walkthroughIntro: Chapter 3 is where the main quest becomes much more exploratory.

Instead of primarily teaching systems, this chapter sends you across the Junkyard and Geartown to hunt for hidden objects, defeat enemies, solve environmental puzzles, and investigate a set of mysterious rune stones.
This is where the walkthrough becomes more detailed, especially for scavenger-hunt and puzzle objectives.

parts.name: Someone Needs It
parts.description: The board wanted the critters thinned out. Small ones, quick ones, the kind that throw stones and run away.
objectives: Defeat Critter Goblins (0/30)
Follow the map to the cave by the river
Recover the Human piece
Recover the Elf piece
Recover the Beastmen piece
Recover the Goblin piece
Set the four pieces into the altar (0/4)
Take what the altar gives back

walkthrough.text: Start by defeating 30 Critter Goblins.
Once that is finished, follow the quest toward the cave by the river.
You now need to recover four separate pieces:
Make sure you have collected all four before returning to the altar.
Set the four pieces into the altar, then take what the altar gives back.
This gives you the first item connected to the rune-stone mystery.

parts.name: Not From This World
parts.description: The stone lit up red and gave something back, a rune stone of some sort.
objectives: Tell Klepon what the altar did
Find the stone on the cliff
Find the stone ball under the fallen bridge
Dig the stone ring out of the trash heaps
Set the ball and the ring on the stone base (0/2)
Align the stone until it finds the sky with two moons
Take the rune from the pedestal in the trash heaps

walkthrough.text: Take what you found back to Klepon and tell him what happened at the altar.
Next, follow the quest to the stone on the cliff.
Find the stone ball underneath the fallen bridge, then find the stone ring in the trash heaps.
Bring both pieces to the stone base and place them into the mechanism.
Adjust the stone until it aligns with the sky containing two moons.
Once the puzzle is solved, take the rune from the pedestal in the trash heaps.

parts.name: Nobody Answered
parts.description: The second stone lit up. Two more are in the town past the gate, but Klepon will want to hear about this one first.
objectives: Tell Klepon what the stone on the cliff gave back
Find the water tower in Geartown
Look at the socket on top of the water tower
Defeat Scarecrow Goblins (0/15)
Defeat Critter Goblins (0/15)
Defeat Buckethead Goblins (0/15)
Set the three cubic stones on the empty socket (0/3)
Turn the stones until the town produces steam
Take the rune from the wheel pedestal

walkthrough.text: Return to Klepon and tell him what the stone on the cliff gave back.
Your next destination is Geartown.
Find the water tower and inspect the empty socket on top.
You now need to defeat:
After completing all three enemy objectives, return to the water tower.
Set the three cubic stones into the empty socket.
Turn the stones until the town begins producing steam.
Once that happens, take the rune from the wheel pedestal.

parts.name: The Color With No Name
parts.description: The sky over the town turned cyan and magenta. One more stone left in the town, Klepon will want to hear about this one too.
objectives: Tell Klepon the sky turned colorful
Find the two pillars past the Crown Mound gate
Find the yellow cog in the market area
Find the orange cog in the trash near the dump trestle
Defeat the Barrel Champion
Defeat Junk King
Set the four cogs into the pillars (0/4)
Turn the cogs until both pillars glow blue
Take the rune from the pedestal behind the Junk King's throne

walkthrough.text: Return to Klepon and tell him that the sky over the town turned colorful.
Find the two pillars past the Crown Mound gate. These pillars are the centerpiece of the next puzzle.
You need four cogs.
Find the yellow cog in the market area and the orange cog in the trash near the dump trestle.
The remaining quest progression also requires defeating the Barrel Champion and Junk King.
Once you have everything required, return to the two pillars.
Set all four cogs into the pillars and turn them until both pillars glow blue.
After solving the puzzle, go behind the Junk King's throne and take the rune from the pedestal.

parts.name: This Door Is Mine
parts.description: Four stones in the bag. Klepon says the man went to the cliff, and his footprints stopped at the wall.
objectives: Tell Klepon the pillars turned blue
Find the cliff wall where the man vanished
Set the four rune stones on the pedestals (0/4)
Open the door
Go inside
Look at the book on the desk

walkthrough.text: Return to Klepon one final time and tell him the pillars turned blue.
Follow the quest to the cliff wall where the man vanished.
At the wall, place the four rune stones onto the pedestals.
Once all four are in position, open the door and head inside.
Find the desk and examine the book sitting on it.
This completes Chapter 3.
